rtl_arabic_guidelines.tailwind_logical_properties: MANDATORY: Use logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, text-start, text-end, border-s, border-e, rounded-s, rounded-e) instead of physical properties (pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-, text-left, text-right) to natively support RTL without layout breaks.
rtl_arabic_guidelines.typography: Use Arabic-specific web fonts. Ensure line heights are 'leading-relaxed' to accommodate Arabic script diacritics.
rtl_arabic_guidelines.icons: Ensure directional icons (arrows, chevrons) are flipped for RTL using 'rtl:-scale-x-100'.

body.family: Cairo, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, sans-serif

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px border of #253959 for structure, add an inner 1px border of white/5 for premium depth.
visual_enhancers.radii: Use rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-2xl for modals, rounded-full for pills and action buttons.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Prioritize density and high-contrast data visualization.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent Arabic text from touching borders.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded-lg. Primary uses gold (#F5B84E) with dark text (#0D1A2E). Secondary uses transparent bg with gold border and gold text.
component_guidelines.cards: Solid surface (#16263F) with subtle border (#253959). Hover states should elevate (-translate-y-1) and increase border brightness.
component_guidelines.inputs: Dark background (#0D1A2E) with border (#253959). Focus state must use ring-1 ring-[#F5B84E] border-[#F5B84E].

implementation_guide.tech_stack: React (.js files, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI
implementation_guide.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case based on their role.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST use .js extensions for React components, not .tsx.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Do not use generic purple gradients or AI-slop aesthetics. Adhere strictly to the Deep Navy (#0D1A2E) and Warm Gold (#F5B84E) palette.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) than usual to give the UI a premium enterprise feel.
All text must be correctly localized in Arabic, utilizing RTL Tailwind logical classes.
For components, utilize Shadcn UI where applicable, customizing the base styles in Tailwind to match the dark/gold theme.
DO NOT use a transparent background for headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use #16263F or glassmorphism (bg-[#16263F]/70 backdrop-blur-xl).
